name: pi-app-kinds
title: Pi agent app default kinds
description: defaultKinds({ locale, comments }): the artifact kinds the pi-app item draws with by default, in order: maquette, diagram, mock-up and records, then Markdown, HTML, SVG, CSV, image and PDF (documentKinds). Pass it as AgentWorkspace's artifactKinds (or ViewerOptions.kinds), with an app's own kinds before it. Each kind loads its viewer on first open.
